description: The paths the server answers with the website's single page (index.html), which routes them itself. Each of library, send and settings may have up to three more segments of letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, starting with a letter or digit; sign-in has none. Any other path that isn't a file is 404. /join and /setup are pages of their own: /setup sets Share up while nobody has an account, the storage folder on a drive and then the first admin.

share_target.notes: The manifest's share_target: Android's share sheet posts files there (multipart, field files) once the website is installed. The service worker takes them into IndexedDB and sends the browser to /send. Without a service worker the server answers 303 to the fallback without reading the files, and the Send page offers to pick them instead.
